selection: Tea-use evidence from museum native names or explicit catalogue descriptions; full institution/accession identity; historical objects and source-specific permissive image licenses. East Asian objects prioritized. No new flat art, textile, fragments, display supports, reflected backgrounds, grouped views or duplicates knowingly admitted.
imageProcess: Local BiRefNet full; original RGB preserved before resize; 1200px lossless-alpha WebP; 10% margin; every accepted image visually checked against its original on black and white.
